title: Synchronous filesystem and child_process operations block the event loop
description: Verified: src/index.ts:93,96 — `execFileSync('git', ['pull']|['clone', ...])` blocks the event loop. src/index.ts:134 — `fs.mkdirSync`, src/index.ts:137 — `fs.existsSync` and `readdirSync` (via listFolders). scripts/set-folder-dates.ts also uses `fs.readdirSync`, `fs.statSync`, `fs.existsSync`, `execFileSync`, `fs.utimesSync`. For a tool syncing potentially hundreds of repos, these synchronous calls block the Bun event loop. Since cloneOrPull is already sequential (no concurrency), the practical impact is limited, but it prevents future concurrency improvements.
spec:
1. Replace `fs.mkdirSync` at src/index.ts:134 with `await fs.promises.mkdir(targetBase, { recursive: true })` (async).
2. Replace `fs.existsSync` and `fs.readdirSync` in listFolders with async equivalents using `fs.promises.access` and `fs.promises.readdir`.
3. Replace `execFileSync` calls in cloneOrPull with `execFile` from `node:child_process/promises` (async, promisified).
4. Make cloneOrPull async (return type becomes `Promise<SyncResult>`) and update the call site at src/index.ts:156 to use `await`.
5. Convert set-folder-dates.ts filesystem operations to async equivalents (`fs.promises.readdir`, `fs.promises.stat`, `fs.promises.utimes`).
6. After async conversion, update the sync loop in runStarsync to use `await` on each cloneOrPull call (sequential remains the default; parallel clone/pull via Promise.all is a separate future enhancement outside the scope of this feature).
7. Verify `bun test` passes after all async conversions.
8. Verify `bun run smoke:qc` passes.
